deviceAccess.note: A fresh uid-1000 process launched after the group change was used for the ordinary-user probe. Existing sessions may need to be restarted to inherit supplementary groups.

gbmProbe.method: Compiled C probe using gbm.h and pkg-config gbm; 64x64 XRGB8888 with GBM_BO_USE_RENDERING

conclusion: The WSLg faux DRM card can allocate a GBM dumb buffer and export a dma-buf, but the GBM EGL display offers no pbuffer/OpenGL ES 2 config; the created surfaceless GLES context reports llvmpipe software rendering. The render node cannot allocate a GBM buffer. This is not hardware rendering evidence and does not establish WPE GBM/DMABUF support. No WPE/WebKit app was run in this experiment. A real DRM host remains required for the P00.4 hardware gate.
